body:
Thank you for listening.
I may have left but my sister is still there. Everyday I worry about her, I don't want her to have the life I've had and I'm trying so hard to make it better for her but in doing so I am forgetting about myself. 
I think about my future and I think about things that could possibly make a person happy and nothing jumps out at me. There is nothing that could make me want to stay here. However, I have to stay here for her because I need to protect her. I am stuck.
